title: Senior Frontend Developer
description: We are seeking a talented Senior Frontend Developer with deep expertise in modern React, TypeScript, and state management architectures. You will lead UI/UX architecture and collaborate directly with product and design teams.
responsibilities: Architect and implement performant, reusable React components and micro-frontends.
Collaborate closely with UX designers to translate wireframes into interactive user experiences.
Optimize web applications for maximum speed, scalability, and cross-browser responsiveness.
Mentor junior front-end engineers and conduct code reviews.
requirements: 4+ years of professional software development experience with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript.
Proficiency with CSS3, CSS Modules, or Tailwind CSS and responsive design principles.
Solid understanding of REST APIs, asynchronous request handling, and state management (Redux/Context API).
Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines.
benefits: Competitive USD-pegged compensation package
Comprehensive health and life insurance for you and your family
Flexible hybrid working environment and annual equipment stipend
Annual performance bonuses and paid time off

title: Full Stack Software Engineer

responsibilities: Design and maintain scalable backend REST APIs using Node.js and PostgreSQL/MongoDB.
Build dynamic and intuitive frontend user interfaces using React and modern component libraries.
Deploy and monitor cloud applications on AWS or GCP infrastructure.
Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for critical application paths.
requirements: 2+ years building full stack web applications with Node.js and React.
Experience with relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB).
Strong understanding of API security, JWT authentication, and rate limiting.
Self-motivated and comfortable working in an asynchronous, remote-first team.
benefits: 100% remote flexibility from anywhere
Home office setup allowance ($1,000)
Learning & development budget for certifications and courses
Unlimited paid time off (minimum 20 days mandatory)

Maintain and evolve our design system with reusable component libraries.
Partner with engineering teams to ensure pixel-perfect design implementation.

Expertise in Figma, FigJam, and rapid prototyping tools.
Understanding of web accessibility standards (WCAG) and responsive design grids.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Daily catered lunches and specialty coffee bar
Bi-annual appraisal cycles and career growth roadmaps
Gym and wellness allowance

title: DevOps & Cloud Engineer
description: Join our platform operations team to maintain multi-region Kubernetes clusters, automated CI/CD deployment pipelines, and zero-trust cloud infrastructure.
responsibilities: Manage and automate Kubernetes clusters deployed on AWS and Google Cloud Platform.
Build declarative Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and Ansible.
Maintain Prometheus, Grafana, and Datadog monitoring and alerting systems.
Conduct security audits, vulnerability scanning, and incident response drill exercises.
requirements: 5+ years in DevOps, SRE, or Systems Administration.
Deep hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and Linux administration.
Extensive experience with Terraform and CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
Solid scripting ability in Bash, Python, or Go.
benefits: Top-tier compensation and equity grant options
Hybrid flexibility (2 days office, 3 days home)
Premium OPD/IPD medical coverage for immediate and extended family
Annual team retreat abroad

Deep understanding of React Native bridge architecture and native styling.
Experience with state management libraries (Zustand, Redux Toolkit).
Strong debugging and profiling skills on Xcode and Android Studio.
benefits: Hourly contract with guaranteed 35-40 hours per week
Opportunity for long-term contract extension or full-time conversion
Flexible working schedule across any time zone
